subject.title: refactor(talk): add realtime voice session harness and adopt in google-meet and voice-call

question: Should the stateful realtime session harness become a supported plugin-SDK contract before the known Discord consumer adopts it?
rationale: This is not solely internal cleanup: it permanently expands the third-party SDK while staging a known compatible bundled consumer for later, so maintainers must confirm whether that public-contract boundary is acceptable.

options.title: Complete all consumers
options.body: Migrate Discord in this PR and validate the final harness against every bundled realtime voice consumer before publishing it.

options.title: Approve staged SDK
options.body: Explicitly accept Google Meet and voice-call first, with a linked bounded Discord follow-up defining compatibility ownership and completion criteria.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Defer the public export until Discord adoption validates the harness API, even if the current consumer refactor must be narrowed or postponed.

recommendation.title: Complete all consumers
recommendation.body: Migrate Discord in this PR and validate the final harness against every bundled realtime voice consumer before publishing it.

likelyOwner.reason: The preceding consolidation commits provide the strongest available ownership trail for this API-direction decision.
